description: This source file defines the 'DisplayFieldGroup' class, part of the OrangeHRM system, representing a group of display fields with database mapping via Doctrine ORM annotations. It includes properties such as id, reportGroup, name, isList, and selectedDisplayFieldGroups, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: DisplayFieldGroup
classes.description: A Doctrine entity class representing a display field group with properties for id, report group, name, list indicator, and associated selected display field groups, with relevant getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the display field group.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the display field group.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the display field group.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the display field group.

methods.name: isList
methods.description: Returns whether this group is designated as a list.

methods.name: setIsList
methods.description: Sets whether this group is designated as a list.
